title: Resume Tailor
summary: A web app that rewrites your resume for a specific job posting with Claude, using only experience already on your resume. Now being rebuilt as an agent that checks every line against your resume.
highlights: 37 tests and CI on every pull request, with the app split into tested services
Scores keyword overlap between your resume and the job description
Imports job postings from a URL and exports to PDF or Word
Accounts, saved history, and Stripe subscriptions, deployed with Docker on Render
problem: Tailoring your resume to every job posting takes a long time. Language models can do it in seconds, but they tend to add skills and numbers you never had. A tailored resume is only useful if every line on it is true.
built: You paste in your resume and a job posting, or a link to one. The app reorders and rewords your experience to match the role, writes a matching cover letter, and shows which keywords from the posting your resume is missing.

The first version makes one model call per feature. The rebuild turns it into an agent with tools, a check that traces every output line back to your original resume, and an eval suite that measures how often it invents something.

milestones.name: MCP server with tools for job posts, company research, and resumes
Agent loop that plans and calls the tools
Grounding check that flags invented experience
Eval suite comparing baseline, agent, and agent with the check
